title: Quantifying the Gaps Between Translation and Native Perception in Training for Multimodal, Multilingual Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in visual perception and object salience across cultures by comparing the frequency, granularity, and categories of object mentions (e.g., foreground vs. background objects) in natively written image captions across various languages.

Quantifying image-text retrieval performance gaps in vision-language models when trained on natively written non-English captions (German) versus captions that are machine-translated or human-translated from English, highlighting the limitations of English-centric pretraining.
